name: room-local
yaml:
room:
  room_configurations:
    record:
      egress:
        room:
          audioonly: true
          audiomixing: 2
          fileoutputs:
            - filepath: room.ogg
              filetype: 1
              disablemanifest: true

name: participant-local
yaml:
room:
  room_configurations:
    record:
      egress:
        participant:
          fileoutputs:
            - filepath: participant.ogg
              filetype: 1

name: track-local
yaml:
room:
  room_configurations:
    record:
      egress:
        tracks:
          filepath: dir.with.dot/track.ogg
          disablemanifest: true

name: nil-outputs
yaml:
room:
  room_configurations:
    record:
      egress:
        participant:
          fileoutputs: [null, {}]

name: composite-filter
yaml:
room:
  room_configurations:
    record:
      egress:
        room:
          webhooks:
            - url: http://127.0.0.1:1
              signingkey: synthetic-api
              filterparams:
                includeevents: [egress_ended]

name: wrong-protojson-key
yaml:
room:
  room_configurations:
    record:
      egress:
        room:
          audio_only: true

name: composite-oneof-preset-shape
yaml:
room:
  room_configurations:
    record:
      egress:
        room:
          options:
            preset: 0

name: track-oneof-storage-shape
yaml:
room:
  room_configurations:
    record:
      egress:
        tracks:
          output:
            s3:
              bucket: synthetic

name: participant-top-preset
yaml:
room:
  room_configurations:
    record:
      egress:
        participant:
          preset: 0
